requirements.assessment: Requirement: Capability permission and risk policy. Existing action intents, durable receipts, recovery claims, at-least-once outbox and generation fences already cover the local supervised-tool path. This is not exactly-once execution across arbitrary remote producers. Linux/WSL shared-workspace and isolated-worker source contracts exist. Docker builds system images; Bubblewrap executes admitted work. An OCI identity does not certify unpacked rootfs content or host isolation. Public Agent/Credential/Ember contracts and a native broker exist. Historical hardware/temporary-key and standalone service descriptions are superseded in deployment by the official Syn-owned runtime contracts. The sandbox Cog path has an optional operator capability policy with bounded denial evidence and PostgreSQL fixture coverage. A managed WSL fixture verified allowed and denied gRPC dispatch on the released Syn worker. Operators can publish versioned PostgreSQL grant sets through the administration CLI. The installed Cog controller and opt-in hosted worker profile check the current grant generation before dispatch. The managed signed worker verified that revocation survives a controller and Syn operator restart with an external PostgreSQL store. Operators can opt into grant pins derived from Syn's verified assignment and signed group epoch. PostgreSQL migration and hosted denial are covered by tests. A managed WSL qualification with two disposable Agents and a disposable schema on the external PostgreSQL server over TLS verified that a live Syn epoch rollover denies the old grant before launch or charge and that an operator can restore audited dispatch by republishing against the new enrollment. Local Python debugger attach checks the selected process lifetime and exact configuration before dispatch. The managed MCP gateway supports principal-pinned installations and refuses cross-principal dispatch. Linux live debugpy and PostgreSQL gateway fixtures verified these paths. Remote debugger policy fixtures verify the selected identity and halt revision through the session boundary, including refusal before dispatch and invalidation when a stop changes during a read. A live debugpy process in a private WSL network namespace verified wrong-probe refusal, stopped inspections, stepping, expired-frame refusal and detach preserving the target. A controlled cut of the private relay while the target was stopped invalidated the session and its stop handle. The target owner verified that the process survived the cut and then stopped it.

Architecture principles
Controller owned invariants
The controller MUST enforce the following invariants in application code and, where practical, database constraints. They must not depend on an LLM remembering
Every action identifies its expected repository state, environment, and requirement revision.
Every execution observation identifies the actual state and execution that produced it.
A passing result on one branch cannot verify another branch.
Sharing a finding does not implicitly merge code or apply a patch.
A model interpretation remains distinct from its source evidence.
Repeated summaries and agreeing models do not create independent observations.
Current explicit requirements and constraints cannot disappear through retrieval or compression.
Applicability, evidence strength, and usefulness remain separate assessments.
Information progress cannot satisfy an implementation acceptance criterion.
Every supplied context packet identifies the exact revisions and evidence it contains.
All work is charged to the task budget, including research, repair, comparison, and consolidation.
Interrupted or indeterminate execution cannot be silently classified as a failed algorithm.
Similarity, a type label, a tool annotation or a server permission flag cannot establish truth, authority, applicability or successful execution.
Exact inventory and complete compliance use explicit enumeration and coverage accounting outside relevance ranking.
Every external invocation is bound to a qualified connection, catalog/schema revision and effect policy; uncertain mutations are reconciled across every routing
